title: Famulus skill manifest (contract C3)
description: Schema for the parsed YAML of a manifest.yaml that ships next to each SKILL.md in a Famulus skill directory. Declares the skill's identity, highest required permission tier, mutation and network behaviour, and the polkit actions and file paths it may use. Consumed by famulus-agentd to enforce the C5 permission policy and to decide when a C4 snapshot is required.

name.description: Skill identifier in kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; starts with a letter or digit; at most 63 characters. Must match the skill's directory name in famulus-skills.

version.description: Skill version as a Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 string (https://semver.org). MUST be written as a quoted YAML string: an unquoted scalar such as 1.0 parses as a float and is rejected.

tier.description: The HIGHEST permission tier any action of this skill may require: 0 = read-only/no-auth, 1 = user-authenticated, 2 = admin-authenticated. Enforced by famulus-agentd via the C5 permission policy.

mutates_system.description: True if the skill can mutate system state under /etc or /var. When true, the runtime MUST take a C4 snapshot (org.famulus.Snapshot1) of the affected subvolumes before executing the skill.

polkit_actions.description: Polkit action IDs under the org.famulus. namespace that the skill may invoke. Unique; may be empty. Tier 0 skills MUST declare none; tier 1 and 2 skills MUST declare at least one.

items.description: A polkit action ID in the org.famulus. namespace, e.g. org.famulus.pkg.install-system.

files_touched.description: Informative declaration of filesystem paths (glob patterns) the skill may write. Unique; may be empty. Audited but not sandbox-enforced in v1.

items.description: A non-empty glob pattern for a path the skill may write, e.g. /var/lib/flatpak/** or ~/.config/dconf/user.

network_access.description: True if the skill may access the network. Declarative and audited, not sandbox-enforced in v1.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the skill does, shown in permission prompts and audit tooling. 1 to 500 characters.
